description: This Java class defines a fragment for handling permission requests within a setup wizard of an Android application. It manages UI interactions for requesting contact and notification permissions, checks permission statuses, and handles user actions such as opening a permissions wiki page or skipping notifications.

classes.name: WizardPermissionsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that manages permission requests for contacts and notifications during setup.

methods.name: getPageLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for the permissions setup page.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets click listeners for permission actions.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Checks if contact and notification permissions are granted.

methods.name: isContactsPermComplete
methods.description: Checks if contacts permission is granted or contacts dictionary is disabled.

methods.name: isNotificationPermComplete
methods.description: Checks if notification permission is granted or skipped.

methods.name: isContactsDictionaryDisabled
methods.description: Checks if contacts dictionary feature is disabled in preferences.

methods.name: refreshFragmentUi
methods.description: Refreshes the UI elements based on permission statuses.

methods.name: setNotificationPermissionCardVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides the notification permission UI group based on permission status.

methods.name: setContactsPermissionCardVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides the contacts permission UI group based on permission status.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on permission-related UI elements.

methods.name: enableContactsDictionary
methods.description: Enables contacts dictionary permission and refreshes UI if permission is granted.
